findings.finding: The printed shifts use sum_j omega_j h_(s-2) rather than h_j. Even after correcting that index, the printed C^|omega| and (-1)^|omega| yield (-1)^(s-2)(s-2)! on an (s-2)-linear diagonal, whereas (13.16) prints +s!.
